title: Loom — pages that load before you blink
description: A benchmark landing page: the same content, built with Weft and with Astro.

hero.title: Pages that load before you blink
hero.lead: Loom renders every page at build time and sends the browser only what it needs.
hero.sub: Static HTML first, one small island where the page has to react, and assets sized for the screen they land on.

image.alt: Green hills under a blue sky with a few clouds

features.title: Rendered at build
features.text: Every route is HTML before the first visitor arrives. No server rendering on the hot path.

features.title: Islands, not apps
features.text: Interactive parts hydrate on their own, when the browser is idle, and nothing else ships JavaScript.

features.title: Pre-compressed
features.text: Brotli and gzip are made once at build, so a request costs a lookup and a write.

counter.title: Try the island
counter.description: The only JavaScript on this page: a counter that hydrates when the browser is idle.

footer: Built for the Weft benchmark. The same content is built with Astro for comparison.
